input.title: Allow ZIP selection for manually installed dictation models
input.body:
Manual dictation model installation could not select `.zip` packages in the native file picker, despite ZIP archives being supported.

- **File selection**
  - Remove the restrictive extension filter.
  - Continue supporting both ZIP packages and prepared model folders.
  - Preserve existing importer validation for supported model packages.

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->

- [REDACTED-CLOSING-REF]
